name: Kristina C.
short: Thank you so much for all of your hard work and special care in creating our perfect wedding cake! … P.S. It was delicious too!
text: Dear Lina and everyone at La Sem Bakery, thank you so much for all of your hard work and special care in creating our perfect wedding cake! From the time we gathered ideas with Lina to the creation and delivery, we were so happy with your service! P.S. It was delicious too!

name: Sara & Justin
short: Everyone loved the delicious, but simple ingredients. Nothing was left behind.
text: To Maria & the La Sem team, thank you for making our wedding cake the best ever! Everyone loved the delicious, but simple ingredients. Nothing was left behind. Your professionalism and experience made our day that much more special.

name: Doris
short: We were all stunned at how incredible the cake looked, it was the talk of the party!
text: Our family wanted to thank you so very much for the AMAZING Nintendo Goomba cake that you created for us. We were all stunned at how incredible the cake looked, it was the talk of the party! It was obvious that you had put a lot of thought and work into making the cake look as fantastic as it did.

name: Alison
text: I just wanted to send you a quick line to thank you very much for the delicious cake you created for my mother. Typically, people would go to you for BIG wedding cakes or cakes for a large group of people. I was nervous to call for such a “small” order, but Maria took such good care of me! Even though my cake was for 20 people, she took the time to go over every detail of my cake order. I could not come into the store, as I lived out of town, but went over cake designs, based on your website pictures. Maria was quick with her prices, suggestions and recommendations. The cake turned out PERFECTLY and to my great surprise, was just as tasty as it was beautiful. You are now my “go to” place for cakes, both big and small.

name: John J Kidd
text: I first discovered La Sem in the ’80s, on Finch Ave. If the amazingly delicious pastries were good then, I’ve been even more impressed by the quality and variety of the baked goods now. A Lady Bug for my wife’s birthday, another design for the other Scorpio birthday crowd, and now everyone in my family and friends are very happy La Sem customers. Now a special order two layer cake for my youngest grandchild, and a lot of little pastries, makes for an exceptionally happy party. Thanks to everyone at La Sem for the gift of great fun cakes that taste as good as they look.

name: Nancy & Louise
text: Thank you, so much, for the beautiful cake for our niece Jasmine. She loved it and we loved it. It was absolutely perfect and delicious. You and your team are great!

name: Julie Mouchbahani
text: I just wanted to say thank you to Maria who took the order. The cake was delicious and the picture was very clear and beautifully decorated. It made my Mother’s 70th birthday special. Thanks for a beautiful job.

name: Clara
text: I wanted to thank you for the beautiful cake you made for my daughter Elona. It was simply beautiful, it tasted like heaven… everyone loved it. Thanks again for all your help. You’re the best!

name: Jennifer & Lyle LeDre
text: We just wanted to thank you all for making us the most lovely cake for our wedding! It looked beautiful and tasted amazing.

name: Linda & Nathan
text: Thank you for creating my dream wedding cake. It was perfect. All of the handmade flowers and ribbons tied in perfect with the colours and theme of our wedding. The cake was delicious! Thank you for adding the details and making our cake look perfect.

name: Josalyn & Craig Radcliffe
text: Thank you so much for helping to design and for making our beautiful wedding cake. It matched our wedding colours perfectly and tasted amazing!

name: Bryan & Michelle McEachern
text: What words can ever tell the joy that we feel remembering that you shared the beginning of our new life together. Thank you all so much for helping to make our wedding day perfect! The cake was absolutely beautiful!

name: Rebecca Digings & Mark Truman
text: Thank you for the beautiful wedding cakes you made for our wedding. They were beautiful and delicious. Sadly there were no leftovers, but our photos will help keep them in our memories.

name: Chris & Susana
text: We wanted to thank you very much for the beautiful cake you made for us, with such good care. Everyone loved your delicious cake. Thank you for helping us every step of the way towards our wedding.

name: Jeny Koshy
text: Please do extend my heartfelt thanks to everyone who made our son such a beautiful birthday cake! We will be coming back to you for all our future occasions!

name: Fernando Fanzutti
text: Just a short note to say thanks for a great birthday cake. We just finished having our cake (sponge rum with hazelnut and chocolate filling), everyone was impressed by the freshness and great taste. For me it’s all about what’s inside that counts, keep up the great work!

name: Noreen Mir
text: Just wanted to thank you sincerely for my son’s STAR WARS birthday cake. It was absolutely delicious, everyone at our party really enjoyed it. We look forward to ordering more cakes from your bakery in the near future!

name: Anne
text: Thank you so much for coordinating with me from afar (USA)!
